name: LSD
tierNotes: Threshold: brick lines barely drifting; colors a notch cleaner than they should be (early colorSat + sharpenHalo carry this tier alone).
Light: color pop unmistakable, faint breathing on large surfaces; still deniable in motion.
Common: full edge-tangent drift, short rainbow-tinged trails; smooth-curve params reach midrange.
Strong: lattice surfaces in texture, long rainbow trails; late params (patternMask, hueDrift, flowWarp) wake up.

Heavy: fractal tiling folds the scene onto itself much more aggressively now (earlier onset, wider blend, sharper unsharp-halo/saturation) — feedback that Heavy wasn't strong enough; everything simultaneous, geometry now genuinely dominates over the photo rather than lightly tiling it.
